name: xArm teach and repeat
summary: Record a movement by moving the xArm by hand, then have it repeat the movement any number of times, slower or faster, and go back to where it started.
help: Teaching by hand for the xArm. In a Controls view: Record puts the arm in manual mode (it holds its own weight and you move it by hand; the payload set in UFACTORY Studio must match what is mounted, or the arm drifts) and records its joints about 50 times a second; Stop ends the recording (the arm holds where it is; still moments at both ends are trimmed and the hand's tremor smoothed). Repeat plays it back Repeats times: the arm first goes to the pose where the movement started (a joint move at Move speed), then follows the recorded joints in the same rhythm (servo mode, 100 commands a second), and at the end goes back to that start pose. The Speed slider (25 % to 150 %) plays it slower or faster, also while it plays; no joint ever goes faster than Max joint speed (where the recording is faster, the playback slows down there). Stop stops the arm at once in any phase; Go to start moves to the start pose; End finishes. Clear the space around the arm: the move to the start pose is a straight joint move. Every recording is saved as recording.csv (t, j1…jN in degrees); connect one to Recording to play it again in another run. Robot model (optional): connect the xArm model block, so the 3D view shows the arm. Robot = simulation sends nothing: a pretend hand moves a pretend arm. Controls (channel "control"): Record, Stop, slider repeats, Repeat, slider speed, Go to start, End. Live: status (text, detail, state, progress), joints.
